# SEO Design Chicago

> SEO Design Chicago is a digital marketing agency in Chicago, Illinois, founded in 2013 by Nick Antonopoulos. We provide search engine optimization (SEO), generative engine optimization (GEO) for AI search, local and multi-location SEO, web design and development, paid media, content creation and analytics for businesses in Chicago and across the United States. Office: 2068 N. Western Ave, 1F Front, Chicago, IL 60647 (Bucktown). Phone: +1-773-677-5747. Email: info@seodesignchicago.com. Team: 10–49 people. Google Partner. Google rating 4.9 from 51 reviews.

## Services
- [SEO services](https://seodesignchicago.com/services/search-engine-optimization-seo/): technical, on-page and off-page SEO for local and national businesses.
- [Chicago SEO](https://seodesignchicago.com/services/seo-services-chicago/): SEO for businesses that serve the Chicago area.
- [Local SEO](https://seodesignchicago.com/services/search-engine-optimization-seo/local-seo/): Google Business Profile, listings and local rankings.
- [Multi-location local SEO](https://seodesignchicago.com/services/multi-location-local-seo/): franchises and multi-store brands.
- [WordPress SEO](https://seodesignchicago.com/services/wordpress-seo-services/): SEO for WordPress sites.
- [Generative engine optimization (GEO)](https://seodesignchicago.com/services/generative-engine-optimization-geo-services/): getting cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.
- [Web design and development](https://seodesignchicago.com/services/web-development/): WordPress, Shopify and ecommerce sites.
- [PPC management](https://seodesignchicago.com/digital-advertising/pay-per-click-ppc-management/): Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, paid social.
- [Content creation](https://seodesignchicago.com/services/content-creation/): SEO content, blog writing, photography and video.
- [Analytics and reporting](https://seodesignchicago.com/services/analytics-and-reporting/): GA4, Tag Manager, Looker Studio, conversion rate optimization.
- [Free SEO analysis](https://seodesignchicago.com/request-a-free-seo-analysis/): request a free audit.

## Pricing
- SEO plans start at $1,000 per month and range up to $20,000 per month for enterprise-level SEO. [SEO packages](https://seodesignchicago.com/seo-packages/)

## Industries
- Multi-location and local businesses, healthcare (dental, senior care), home services, manufacturing. [All industries](https://seodesignchicago.com/digital-marketing-industries/)

## Service area
- Chicago and the Chicago suburbs ([areas we serve](https://seodesignchicago.com/areas-we-service/)); clients nationwide.

## Proof
- [Case studies](https://seodesignchicago.com/case-studies/)
- [Assisted living](https://seodesignchicago.com/case-studies/assisted-living-marketing-strategies-case-study/): 298% increase in tour bookings; occupancy from 75% to 94%.
- [Multi-location dental practice](https://seodesignchicago.com/case-studies/dental-seo-marketing-strategies-case-study/): 312% increase in organic search traffic; 189% increase in new patient appointments.
- [Manufacturing startup](https://seodesignchicago.com/case-studies/manufacturing-startup-marketing-strategies-case-study/): 331% increase in organic search traffic; 248% increase in qualified sales leads.
- Clients include Singer Safety, American Thermal Windows, Lieberman Companies, Jon Nelson and Henry Sykes.
- Certifications: [Google Partner](https://www.google.com/partners/agency?id=2571956607).

## Company
- [About](https://seodesignchicago.com/about/): founded 2013 by Nick Antonopoulos, 20+ years in SEO, paid search and digital marketing.
- [Contact](https://seodesignchicago.com/contact-us/)
- [Careers](https://seodesignchicago.com/careers/)
- [Blog](https://seodesignchicago.com/blog/)

## Related
- [Custom Web Audits](https://app.customwebaudits.com/): the website audit platform built by SEO Design Chicago.

class="brxe-text"><p>On-page SEO refers to SEO efforts that are made on your own web pages in order to boost search traffic. Your website is the central hub when it comes to your company’s online presence. It should be a place where any customer or potential customer goes to find out anything they need to know about you.</p></div><div id="brxe-zozruh" class="brxe-text"><p>Your website should house comprehensive web pages with <a href="https://seodesignchicago.com/services/search-engine-optimization-seo/content-optimization-analysis/" data-wpel-link="internal">optimized content</a> and title tags that cover all aspects of your business. This offers a multitude of options for search engines to draw from when it comes to fulfilling search queries.</p></div><div id="brxe-cnqih3" class="brxe-text"><p>Some of the most important factors for successful on-page SEO are optimizing meta descriptions and alt text. By labeling images with an accurate representation of what they are, you show search engines why your content should move closer to the top page of Google for a specific term. Alternative text is also an important requirement for <a href="https://seodesignchicago.com/website-design-tips/what-is-ada-compliance-for-websites/" data-wpel-link="internal">ADA-compliant websites</a>.</p></div><div id="brxe-o3chur" class="brxe-text"><p>Also, you can improve your on-page SEO through keyword research and implementation, which is showcased in the content you create. Knowing which keywords are relevant to your business is an essential SEO task. Finding which keywords are being searched for, but are underrepresented in search results, is the true goal when it comes to finding good keywords.</p></div><div id="brxe-swf1hy" class="brxe-text"><p>Once you have these keywords, you’ve got to put them into action. The best way to do this is by creating content around them. Making web pages on your website that hold these keywords will not only drive traffic, but they will fill your website with informative pages that can be referenced at any time. Many keywords are questions for which a potential customer might be searching.</p></div></div></section><section id="brxe-sngnsu" class="brxe-section"><div id="brxe-ff37fc" class="brxe-container"><h2 id="brxe-wkyr0i" class="brxe-heading"><a >Technical SEO</a></h2><div id="brxe-xv6ytp" class="brxe-div"></div><div id="brxe-f24n66" class="brxe-text"><p>Technical SEO refers to all of the SEO tasks that don’t relate to creating content. Many of these tasks pertain to fixing possible website operation issues. Some of these technical SEO tasks are mobile display capabilities, loading speeds, website architecture, and security. These <a href="https://seodesignchicago.com/services/consulting/website-updates/" data-wpel-link="internal">website updates</a> all help modernize your website, keeping it professional and on par with what your competitors are offering.</p></div><div id="brxe-9kwqfa" class="brxe-text"><p>By updating your website, you are doing more than just changing how things look. When we work to improve a client’s website, there are always performative reasons for why we make changes. With so many people visiting websites on their phones, it’s important to have a mobile display that not only looks nice but operates in a smooth and effective manner so that these visitors are receiving the same viewing experience as those on a desktop.</p></div><div id="brxe-td0s9t" class="brxe-text"><p>With the updates to Google PageSpeed Insights, it is essential that all of your web pages are optimized for mobile devices and load as quickly as possible. Internal links pointing to outdated content or 404 errors need to be corrected.</p></div><div id="brxe-8vkyh6" class="brxe-text"><p>Making sure your website loads efficiently saves viewers from potential headaches. A website that is hard to navigate is a digital maze. It can be hard to house an influx of web pages without having a clear plan for how they should be laid out. A site’s architecture can be just as important as its content.</p></div><div id="brxe-uyp6p9" class="brxe-text"><p>Having a verified, secure website is a barrier of defense that makes everyone feel a little safer operating on the internet. Moreover, security is important for SEO because Google prioritizes secure websites over unsecured websites in search results. There are a multitude of technical elements to strengthen on your website in order to improve user experience and SEO.</p></div></div></section><section id="brxe-rmvrv7" class="brxe-section"><div id="brxe-tb0nzc" class="brxe-container"><h2 id="brxe-85c6o3" class="brxe-heading">Off-Page SEO</h2><div id="brxe-fzg8yj" class="brxe-div"></div><div id="brxe-lraqn8" class="brxe-text"><p><a href="https://seodesignchicago.com/seo-tips/differences-between-on-site-seo-and-off-site-seo/" data-wpel-link="internal">Off-page SEO</a> is the twin to on-page SEO. The main difference here is that off-page SEO encapsulates all SEO efforts made outside of your website. These are all of the other links, accounts, and listings that have your name associated with them on the internet. Social media accounts, Google and <a href="https://seodesignchicago.com/services/search-engine-optimization-seo/bing-places/">Bing maps</a> listings, reviews, and news articles mentioning your business are all examples of off-page SEO.</p></div><div id="brxe-rqd6gv" class="brxe-text"><p>All of these different types of off-page SEO are important to boosting your company’s SEO because they show your array of influence on the internet. It’s one thing for a potential customer to read about how great you are from your own website. However, when they see that others feel that way as well and are willing to write about it on the internet, it makes a stronger statement.</p></div><div id="brxe-ada8d2" class="brxe-text"><p>The ultimate goal for SEO is to have a variety of different sources show up mentioning you when someone searches for your business or industry.</p></div><div id="brxe-68l9ir" class="brxe-text"><p>Some ways to boost your off-page SEO are through increasing your social media presence. Once people are following and interacting with your account, the traffic will start to drive itself. A strong <a href="https://seodesignchicago.com/services/content-creation/social-media-content-creation/">social media content creation</a> strategy should encompass multiple platforms. Furthermore, you should maintain a consistent posting schedule. This will draw in and increase followers and lead to more interest in your business.</p></div></div></section><section id="brxe-ar7qhd" class="brxe-section"><div id="brxe-2qmbxw" class="brxe-container"><h2 id="brxe-9xn02j" class="brxe-heading">Ecommerce SEO</h2><div id="brxe-99krdu" class="brxe-div"></div><div id="brxe-x3rq99" class="brxe-text"><p>Ecommerce SEO deals with many of the aforementioned SEO components and adds additional web design factors that contribute to on-page and technical SEO factors. Many of Google’s internal tools offer the best insight into new keyword ideas. <a href="https://seodesignchicago.com/search-engine-optimization-tips/how-to-use-google-trends/" data-wpel-link="internal">Google Trends</a> is a great place to discover what’s popular in different regions.
